questions.question: What does modus ponens conclude?
options: Q from P and P implies Q
not P from rule and not Q
P from the value Q alone
options_ar: Q من P ومن P يستلزم Q
ليس P من القاعدة وليس Q
options_en: Q from P and P implies Q
not P from rule and not Q
P from the value Q alone
questions.explanation: Modus ponens concludes Q from P and the rule P implies Q.
questions.explanation_ar: الاستدلال الأمامي يستنتج Q من P ومن القاعدة P يستلزم Q.

questions.question: What does the backward rule conclude?
options: not P from rule and not Q
Q from P and the given rule
P from the value Q alone
options_ar: ليس P من القاعدة و Q
options_en: not P from rule and not Q
Q from P and the given rule
P from the value Q alone
questions.explanation: Modus tollens concludes not P from the rule and not Q.
questions.explanation_ar: الاستدلال العكسي يستنتج ليس P من القاعدة ومن ليس Q.

questions.question: How is the GMP conclusion computed?
options: R equals A prime composed B
B prime equals R minus A prime
B prime equals A prime composed R
A prime equals B prime composed R
options_en: R equals A prime composed B
B prime equals R minus A prime
B prime equals A prime composed R
A prime equals B prime composed R
questions.explanation: GMP computes the conclusion B prime as A prime composed with R.
questions.explanation_ar: التعميم الأمامي يحسب B' كتركيب A' مع R.

questions.question: A crisp measured input acts as what in inference?
questions.question_ar: المدخل الحاسم المقاس يعمل كـماذا في الاستدلال؟
questions.explanation: A measured input is treated as a fuzzy singleton at that value.
questions.explanation_ar: المدخل المقاس يُعامل كمجموعة أحادية عند تلك القيمة.

questions.question: With several rules, how are clipped consequents combined?
questions.question_ar: مع عدة قواعد، كيف تُجمع اللواحق المقصوصة؟
questions.explanation: Several clipped consequents are combined by union, taking the maximum.
questions.explanation_ar: عدة لواحق مقصوصة تُجمع بالاتحاد، بأخذ الأقصى.

questions.question: Which is a defuzzification method family?
questions.question_ar: أي عائلة من طرائق إزالة التغبيش هذه؟
questions.explanation: The families are maxima, centroid methods and weighted average.
questions.explanation_ar: العائلات هي العظمى وطرائق المركز والمتوسط الموزون.

questions.question: How is the centre of gravity computed?
options: the largest grade in the set
the mean of the two peak values
sum of grades over point count
options_en: the largest grade in the set
the mean of the two peak values
sum of grades over point count
questions.explanation: CoG is the sum of x times grade divided by the sum of grades.
questions.explanation_ar: مركز الثقل مجموع x في الدرجة مقسوماً على مجموع الدرجات.

questions.question: Which method does Takagi-Sugeno use for its output?
questions.explanation: Takagi-Sugeno uses a weighted average of the peak positions.
questions.explanation_ar: تاكاغي-سوغينو يستخدم متوسطاً موزوناً لمواضع القمم.
